reason: This research gap aims to investigate whether the proportion of SUID cases with maternal health conditions during pregnancy has changed over time from 2008 to 2019 using a case series (NCFRP) and a population reference (PRAMS). The design can only compare trends in proportions among SUID cases but cannot establish incidence, rates, or causation. It addresses an important knowledge gap regarding the longitudinal relationship between maternal health conditions during pregnancy and SUID, which has not been extensively studied before.
